svg.font-family: system-ui, 'Segoe UI', Inter, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: S — Origami · Thrills & Chills round-5 art concept
svg.text: Folded paper, not stacked paper: every object is a few
creased planes, lit by its fold. Pleated carousel roof,
crane seats, paper-boat cars, a folding screen behind.

g.text: Plane tone = its angle to the light + a soft ramp.
Creases: mountain = pale line, valley = dark line.
Folds, not layers: no outlines, no stacked edges.
Shadows: soft, the paper lifts off the sheet.
Riders sit on cranes and in paper boats.
